title: Khaitan & Co advises DOMS on acquisition of Reynolds Pens
description: Doms Industries Limited has acquired the worldwide rights to the ‘Reynolds’ brand and other identified assets, contracts, employees and liabilities from Reynolds Pens India and five other entities (all subsidiaries of Newell Brands Inc.) for $3.7 million.Khaitan & Co advised DOMS on this acquisition.
